test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An aeroplane covers a distance of 900 km in 1.5 hours. What is the speed of the aeroplane?
solution:
Given:

Distance = 900 Km

Time = 1.5 hr

Concept Used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Speed = 900/1.5

Speed = 600 km/her

∴ The required speed is 600 km/hr.
